arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong hooks to maintain an uplifting atmosphere in mainstream boom bap style.

event_markers.label: hook
event_markers.reason: Strong hook starts with energetic vocals

event_markers.label: verse_2
event_markers.reason: Second verse with sparse vocal energy

slicer.description: Channels named by sample slicing technique

sound_intent.overall: Uplifting boom bap with a clean, spacious groove emphasizing sample chop techniques in layers.
sound_intent.drums: Punchy but sparse drum hits focusing on clear rhythmic placement in verses with fuller presence in hooks.
sound_intent.bass: Warm and supportive bass lines that enhance hooks and remain minimal during verses.
sound_intent.chords: Subtle chord chops enhancing texture, especially in hooks and bridge sections.
sound_intent.melody: Bright melodic chops appearing mainly in hooks to lift mood without cluttering verses.
sound_intent.vocal: Sparse vocal elements in verses building to strong, engaging hooks.
sound_intent.fx: Light, tasteful effects emphasizing transitions between sections.

routing_intent.drums: Separate channel for sliced drum samples routed through dedicated compression and saturation nodes.
routing_intent.bass: Clean routing to bass bus with EQ emphasizing low mids.
routing_intent.chords: Multi-channel routing for different chord chops allowing for dynamic control.
routing_intent.melody: Layered routing with automation on effects levels for hooks to increase energy.
routing_intent.vocal: Dry signal channel with parallel effects chain for vocal hooks.
routing_intent.fx: Send-return configuration for global effects with selective routing.

designer_intent.emphasis: Maintain clear contrast between sparse verses and powerful hook sections with sample chop layers to reinforce boom bap style.

presetor_intent.goal: Use presets emphasizing punch, clarity, and warmth to fit the boom bap mainstream uplifting style and energy profile.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns that are sparse during verses and punchy with swing during hooks, emphasizing sample slicing techniques.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass parts that support groove subtly in verses and intensify during hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chord chops and harmonic progressions that uplift the mood, using sample slicing for texture.

melody_generator.brief: Design melodic hooks that stand out in hooks sections, using chopped sample layers for phrasing.

ai_designer.brief: Ensure arrangement dynamics flow with energy shifts between verses and hooks, keeping sparse verses and strong hooks.

presetor.brief: Select and tweak presets to complement boom bap sample chops, focusing on uplifting tonal characteristics and clarity.

songgps.brief: Monitor arrangement energy profile and section transitions to maintain coherence and uplifting atmosphere.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix channels preserving sample chop articulation, balancing sparse verses with energetic hooks seamlessly.
